bio.text: Josh Green, a physician, is Hawaii's ninth Governor; according to the governor's office biography, he was elected in December 2022.

According to that biography, he was raised in Pittsburgh, earned degrees in biology and anthropology from Swarthmore College and an M.D. from Penn State's College of Medicine, and then served in Ka'u on Hawaii Island as a member of the National Health Service Corps.
He served two terms in the Hawaii House of Representatives, three terms in the Hawaii State Senate and a term as lieutenant governor before becoming governor.
